name: tehprof-support
description: Work with your TehProf Support helpdesk from ChatGPT: see open and overdue tickets, read a ticket, find the answer in the knowledge base and draft a reply, with every action that reaches a customer confirmed by you.

interface.longDescription:
TehProf Support is a helpdesk for service teams: customer requests from WhatsApp, Telegram, email and Bitrix24 become tickets with SLA, a knowledge base and analytics. This connector lets your AI assistant work with your own Support account in plain words.

Ask "which tickets are overdue?", "what is waiting for my answer?" or "how did the team do today?" and get an answer built from your real tickets. The assistant can open a ticket, look for an answer in your knowledge base, draft a reply, add an internal note, take a ticket or set a reminder.

The assistant sees exactly what you see in Support — your company, your role, your tickets. Anything that reaches a customer or changes a ticket's state (replying, completing, reassigning, changing settings) is marked as a destructive action and needs your explicit confirmation first. Internal notes and tags never reach the customer and are added as ordinary edits. You can disconnect the assistant at any time in Support → Connect AI.
defaultPrompt: Which tickets are overdue right now?
What is waiting for my answer?
How did the team do today?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists open tickets with customer, subject, status and age.
Returns tickets that broke or are about to break the SLA.

positive.prompt: How did the team do today?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns counts of new, closed and open tickets and response times.

positive.description: Read a ticket and draft an answer without sending
positive.prompt: Open the latest ticket and suggest an answer from the knowledge base
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the ticket, finds a matching article and shows a draft; nothing is sent.

positive.prompt: Add an internal note to the latest ticket: customer asked to call after 3 pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the internal note on the ticket and says so; the note is not sent to the customer.

negative.description: General writing, no helpdesk data needed
negative.prompt: Write a polite apology email template for a delayed delivery.
What is a good first response time for a B2B support team?
Remind me to buy milk tomorrow morning.

publication.release_notes: First public release: tools for tickets, SLA analytics, the knowledge base, contacts, quick replies and reminders. Read-only tools need no confirmation; every action that reaches a customer or changes a ticket's state is marked destructive and is confirmed by the user; internal notes and tags never reach the customer.
